latestVersion.changelog:
Best Video Compressor — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Easily compress large video files (up to 500MB) using cloud-based AI without local setup.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM file uploads and delivers compressed MP4 exports in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic setup with token acquisition and secure, session-based processing.
- Integrated workflows for exporting, uploading, checking credits/balance, and monitoring progress.
- Real-time feedback and error handling for all typical video compression and export requests.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and students needing smaller video files without visible quality loss.
